summary: Wake reconciliation when native harness observations are admitted

replay.detail: No replay, migration or rebuild. Native observation records and durable publications are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and canonical folds are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, driver or client contract change. Exact native event replays and usage observations remain quiet.

recovery.detail: An admitted local harness observation now wakes reconciliation so ready work and idle-unclaimed deadlines are re-evaluated. Existing work selection, permission fences, bounded wake attempts and five-minute diagnostic policy are unchanged.
